name: Turkish coffee
description: Very finely ground coffee brought to a foam in a cezve and served with the grounds.

tcm.note: Read with coffee; unfiltered and concentrated.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; the Unani record on qahwa is explicit.

histamine.note: Read as coffee, and the grounds stay in the cup.

nutrition.highlight: the grounds stay in the cup

stimulant.note: Caffeine alone, and the grounds stay in the cup.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
